verifiedBy: Claude (Scope 3 completion I-03 builder: programmatic read of the official CSV; FRED index transcribed and cross-checked), 2026-10-30
method: EPA Supply Chain GHG Emission Factors v1.3.0 (CO2e, 2017 NAICS-6, kg CO2e per 2022 USD purchaser price, IPCC AR5 GWP-100 applied by EPA, U.S. GHG data for 2022) read programmatically from the official CSV: for each of the 1,016 codes the published "with margins" (cradle to shelf) and "without margins" (cradle to factory gate) values exactly as printed; the with-margins value is never recomputed as SEF + MEF (110 rows differ by 0.001). Electricity (221100) is not in the file. Price index: BEA GDP implicit price deflator (FRED A191RD3A086NBEA), an economy-wide approximation of EPA's commodity-specific deflation, transcribed from two FRED pages that agree.

source.publisher: U.S. EPA Office of Research and Development
source.title: Supply Chain Greenhouse Gas Emission Factors for US Industries and Commodities (SupplyChainGHGEmissionFactors_v1.3.0_NAICS_CO2e_USD2022.csv)
source.edition: v1.3.0, 5 July 2024 (doi 10.23719/1531143); licence: EPA ScienceHub, public domain, https://pasteur.epa.gov/license/sciencehub-license.html
